_comment: Copy to platforms/evm-secrets.local.json (gitignored) and fill in. `scripts/build.mjs --evm` / vite read it (or the ALCHEMY_API_KEY env var) and inject the key into the EVM registry as the FIRST RPC endpoint and the history/token source for chains with an `alchemyNetwork`. A store build never carries it. Anything in an extension bundle is public: this is a development key; the release path is the gateway on network.satorigo.app (platforms/evm-gateway.json), with which no client key is needed. Also: clientToken is the gateway's X-Satori-Client value (must match the gateway CLIENT_TOKENS); baked into --evm gateway builds; not a secret (public bundle) but kept out of git for easy rotation. Or set EVM_CLIENT_TOKEN in the environment.
